title: rosa × collina var. fastigiata
intro: Rosa × collina var. fastigiata, commonly known as the Hybrid Tea Rose, is a type of ornamental flowering plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Rosa × collina var. fastigiata include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative and analgesic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
